name: Run In The Park
description:
Come and join the original Zwift group run! 

This event is a 5km mass start event and runs at multiple times every Saturday.  

It is open to runners of all abilities so whether you are a recreational runner or an elite athlete you are welcome on the start line.  

Get to the start gates early to chat with the other runners, you may find someone of a similar ability to group up with for the run.  

There is no time limit for completing the event so run at your own pace and enjoy the course.

description:
The Time Trial. Cycling’s true leveler - just you and your legs versus everyone else in the field.

name: Chaser the Pacer!
description:
This is a different type of chase event.

Everyone has to complete one lap of Mountain Mash - only 5.7km.

Every category is led by a Robo Pacer, configured so that their power output is at the top end of the pace group. They are all set up so that they should finish *extremely* closely together.

Jump into your category and try to keep up with the pacer and see how near to the front you finish!

name: OWL.BiKe Women's Grey Zone: Meet. Play. Ride.
description:
This is your weekly space to meet, play, and ride together while we spin in the sweet spot of the Grey Zone. Our rubber-banded rides keep things inclusive and welcoming, so no one gets dropped—just a smooth, social ride at an easy pace.

But this isn’t just a ride. Along the way, we bring in a playful, gamified quiz experience designed to spark conversation, curiosity, and connection. Topics range from light and fun to meaningful and empowering, with a focus on celebrating and uplifting women.

Come for the ride, stay for the vibe—this is where community, conversation, and movement meet.

name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO race series. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

name: Torturefest | ITT Climbing League | City and the Sgurr | Week 1
description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.

Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift

These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder bike choices. 
•	No draft regardless of bike.
•	No Power up’s just you and your watts.
•	Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only 10km, elevation is primary focus.
•	Category enforced, must wear HRM.
•	ZwiftPower league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to zwift power.
•	Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
•	What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has multiple climbs?
•	How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?  

One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing Russian roulette style.

name: ZZRC Rollers Sub 2
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Rollers Sub 2. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 1.7-1.9 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be sub 2 .

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .


We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel for our sub 2
https://discord.gg/RJ3dhbjCEp


TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: Tour Ignite - Stage 7
description:
Flamme Rouge Racing are excited to bring you our 6th tour Series, 3 Tour events from October through to March.

These will be PUBLIC availble events but if you want to be part of the official rankings then you will need to register and understand the rules, just visit.
Tours are special places, multi day events designed to test riders enduracne and resolve - so if you are popping in then enjoy the race be part of the race without destroying it as it's not a normal race.

https://www.flammerougeracing.com

Tour Aim
Multi day stage mixed racing for all classes of rider, generate fatigue and test how far you can go against your class. 
Anyone can race hard once a week but can you be competitive over a multiday event...only one way to find out!

Classification & PEN placement
ZRS wil place you in one of 5 staggered start Pens and your vELO class will rank you - Refer to the FRR Tour Rules page for mor einformation

Event Race Passes
Events are PUBLIC - join any race any time - your first completed race will count

Tour Rules
Ensure you are aware of the rules of the Tour to help you plan your survival strategy, all information can be found on our website...

Event Basics
- For each stage there are multiple race times
- Refer to the SCHEDULE page on the website for courses
- ALL SEGMENTS are in play 
- ALL RESULTS can be found on the website under the relevant page, these will periodically update through the day
- Keep going until the distance to go says 0 just in case there are some custom finishes

- There are no power ups for any stage
- Points stages use the ZWIFT AERO bike frame or TRON, ITT stages use the Zwift standard TT bike frame - riders may choose their own wheels
- Steering is always OFF

Tour Competition Awards
- Individuals can compete for GC (eGAP Time) / Polka Jersey / Sprint - by Gender for all classes

Queen/King Stage
Double points will be awarded as highlighted by the Schedule and/or Roadbook

Communication
Discord - Tour channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything on the Tour

Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS

Smart Trainers, Power Meters & HRM
- Events will not allow riders to join without a recognised Smart Trainer beign connected
- Smart Trainers are expected to be used as a riders PRIMARY POWER SOURCE where possible (Spin bikes must be declare to Race Control as these are NOT classed as smart trainers)
- POWER METERS can be used as Primary source if a Smart Trainer is not available
- Riders must understand that if verification is required that Race Control can verify with the Zwift platform if a rider has used a power meter as a primary power source over a smart trainer.

HRMs are strongly advised, the only reason we do not make them mandatory on joining an event is that sometimes they fail or batteries stop mid race so we do not want to penalise the accidents, however riders with little or no history we wil encourage to merchandise.

Why is this important - Video's may show that a riders BIO is fine and their setup looks good but this doesn't confirm that's what they used - we can now verify the trainer connected where required because it is known that PMs data can be altered and settings tweaked to produce more power.

So be SMART and use a SMART trainer as your PRIMARY power source where you can....

FRR Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anything more will be removed and warnings/bans will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the FRR events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt then welcome to the fun zone...! 
(But stop if it really does hurt too much please!)

name: EVO CC Sprint Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO sprintrace series. Shorter more compact races for the rider looking for an effective high intensity race. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

name: 2026 SISU World Championships - Gravel
description:
Coinciding with the 2026 UCI Road World Championships in Montréal, SISU Racing is excited to announce the 2026 SISU Worlds.
Across two weekends in September, riders will take on the ultimate test of speed, strength and race craft as we crown our 2026 SISU World Champions.


Individual Time Trial
19 - 20 September
Triple Flat Loops | Watopia
The Worlds begin with the race of truth. No drafting, nowhere to hide — just you, the clock and the watts.


Road Race
26 - 27 September
Bambino Fondo | Watopia
One week later, it’s time for the rainbow battle. Expect tactics, attacks, teamwork and a fight all the way to the line.


Gravel
10-11 October
Handful of Gravel | Watopia x 5 laps

It’s time to get dusty!


In true SISU style, we’re adding something extra.
Alongside our individual World Champions, we’ll also crown an Overall Champion in each grade (iTT + Road Race + Gravel) and SISU Country Champions, with the result determined by the combined times of the fastest three riders from each country.
Pull on your national colours, rally your compatriots and race for something bigger than yourself.


Further Information
Open event using Zwift's Racing Score with separate Women’s GC 
Each event is a mass start with all riders visible on the course.
TT bikes are mandatory for the iTT. Draft will be disabled.
Z Power and riders without heart rate data will be excluded from the results.
A rider's best time will count if they race the same discipline multiple times.
To be included in the GC riders must have a Zwiftpower profile.

name: Herd Summer Racing League
description:
Welcome to the Herd Summer Racing League (HSRL)

HSRL is a series of points races. The race format can be a little bit different week to week, but in
most of the races you score points for your time on each of the segments (FTS), versus the times
set by the other competitors. You also score bonus points for your finishing position in the race
versus your competitors in your category. Each week the race format, segments and points for
this race will be posted at the Herd Racing League facebook group and on the Herd Racing
discord channel.

General Classification

The points in each race are used to determine your ranking for the race. Your race rank
determines how many league points you receive, with the winner scoring 50 points, 2nd place
getting 49 and so on, down to 1 point for 50th place. Each week there are six different events to
choose from - choose whichever suits your schedule best.

Schedule

21-23 August: Scotland After Party - ITT + FTS
28-30 August: Innsbruckring (3 laps) - Points race FTS + FIN
4-6 September: Double Espresso - Points race FTS + FIN
11-13 September: Downtown Eruption - Scratch race
18-20 September: BRAEk-fast Crits & Grits - Points race FTS + FIN
25-27 September: Hot Laps - Points race FAL + FIN
2-4 October: Twilight Crit (6 laps) - Points race FTS + FIN
9-11 October: London Uprising - Points race FTS + FIN

Race rules:

1. Smarttrainer or powermeter required.
2. Cadence sensor required.
3. Heart rate monitor required.
4. No indoor bikes without controlled resistance (cadence=power).
5. Participants must be registered on zwiftpower.com to be included in the results.
6. For elite level performances the race organiser can request additional data to verify the
performance.
7. For podium finishers in all categories: Zwift activities must be saved PUBLIC for verification.

For more information please see our Facebook Group:
https://www.facebook.com/groups/zHerdRacing

name: PACK Run Hill Training: Surrey
description:
PACK Beginner Hill Training is a group workout designed to help runners get familiar with running with incline. This is a free run event meaning there is no set pace you must go, but there will be incline prompts that attempt to mimic the terrain of the course. The inclines are based on distance, so you will always be given prompts based on your progression in the workout. If some of the gradients are too challenging for you, feel free to decrease the incline, but don't make it too easy. The leader will typically follow the pace chart below, but may adjust depending on the group dynamics.

Note: We will not always be matching Zwift gradients, so it is important to pay attention to the instructions. Typically the adjusted incline will be half of what is being displayed in the upper righthand corner.

As a general guide: 
--------------------------
0 - 1% = 10.2kph / 6.3 mph
2% - 9.9 kph / 6.2 mph
3% = 9.7 kph / 6.0 mph
4% = 9.3 kph / 5.8 mph 
5% = 9 kph / 5.6 mph
6% = 8.7 kph / 5.4 mph
7% = 7.4 kph / 5.2 mph
--------------------------

If you'd like Zwift to record your elevation in the fit file, you'll need to either have a direct connect treadmill or use an app like Pascal's Runcline for iOS, TSS app for iOS, or Runn module from North Pole Engineering.

Finally, if the hills don't wear you out, there will be an optional 500 meter sprint to the finish and optional after party of 2-4km to boot!

So put PACK in your name, get your black shirt and shorts on, and let's tackle those hills!

https://www.facebook.com/groups/zwiftpack/

name: JETT Endurance Ride 100km 2.5~3.3w/kg
description:
JETT Endurance Ride !!
Let's ride 2.5w/kg~3.3w/kg !!
B category's average of power is 3.0~3.3w/kg, start is 2.5w/kg for grouping.
C category's average of power is 2.5~2.9w/kg, start is 2.0w/kg for grouping.

Double draft is on.

Rule of this group ride
· You always keep grouping in mind
· Do not Lead from Leader - yellow beacon
· Keep stay around Yellow Beacon
· TT Bike is allowed but TT bike cant get drafting effect.
· If you exceed the Fence, return to Yellow Beacon at 2.0w/kg or less.

*There are several Sweepers on this group ride. If you have dropped, please
request 'Help' in ZWIFT Chat if you need help. A sweeper goes for help.
However, we can not help without the offer of 'HElp'.

Follow endurance ride for 2 hours and 30 minutes, follow leader
instructions and enjoy ZWIFT chat, let's work together and make the best
group, the best workout!

※Please note that we will flag you if you lead at abnormal speed.

JETT Endurance Ride
休日の朝を100kmを2.5w/kg~3.3w/kgでライドしましょう！
B categoryの平均パワーは、3.0~3.3w/kgです。スタートは2.5w/kgでグルーピングします。
C categoryの平均パワーは、2.5~2.9w/kgです。スタートは2.0w/kgでグルーピングします。

ダブルドラフトはオンです。

このグループライドのルール
・常にグルーピングを心がけること
・Yellow Beaconから離れないでライドしましょう
・TT Bikeは使用可能ですが、Drafting効果を得られません。
・Fenceをオーバーした場合は、2.0w/kg以下でYellow Beaconまで戻りましょう。

*このグループライドにはスイーパーが何名かいます。もし，ドロップしてしまった時，支援が必要な時はZWIFT
Chatで'Help'と申し出てください。スイーパーが助けに行きます。しかし，'HElp’の申し出がない限り助けには行けません。
2時間30分の耐久ライド、リーダー指示に従い、またZWIFTチャットを楽しみながら、みんなで協力し最高のグループ、最高のワークアウトにしましょう！

※異常なスピードでリードした場合、あなたにフラグを立てますので注意して下さい。

#jett #japan

name: Tiny Race (1 of 4) by Zwift Insider
description:
IMPORTANT: read these notes to perform your best and avoid disqualification!

Tiny Races are mean to be raced as set of 4 back-to-back events that finish within one hour. Each race is on a different route that takes ~7-12 minutes to complete, and races are scheduled 15 minutes apart.

3 RULES:
- No skipping then returning. You will receive a DQ if you skip race 1, 2, or 3 but finish a later race in the set.
- You must have an active ZwiftPower account to compete for the overall podium.
- Smart trainer or power meter is required.

THIS WEEK'S ROUTES:
Race 1: Serpentine 8 (5.5km ends on rise climbing out of Mayan cutoff) - Powerup: Feather
Race 2: Volcano Flat Reverse (5.5km, ending atop Dirty Sorpressa) - Powerup: Steamroller
Race 3: Watopia Flat Route (5.23km, ends at bridge after Fishing Village) - Powerup: Draft 
Race 4: Jungle Circuit Reverse (6.289km, ends at Jungle Arch) - Powerup: Anvil

PRO TIPS: 
You will receive a single powerup at the start of each race, as listed above. Be sure to visit https://zwiftinsider.com/tiny/ for details on this week's routes, including custom finish line locations.

RESULTS:
You earn points in each race based on your finishing position. The overall category winners each week (available on ZwiftPower) are the riders with the most points across all 4 races. ZwiftPower result links:
- Zone 1 (9am UTC): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1172
- Zone 2 (3pm UTC): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1173
- Zone 3 (9pm UTC): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1174

name: RollCo: Rolling Tide - 36K
description:
🌊 ROLLING TIDE
Start small. Build big.
Welcome to Rolling Tide — RollCo’s season-long ritual race.

Every week, the distance grows by 1 km.
It begins as a short, explosive opener and steadily evolves into a full-distance endurance epic by year’s end.
This isn’t a one-off event — it’s a shared journey that rises with you.

🏁 Race Format
Rolling Tide is a categorised scratch race.
All riders start together, with categories keeping the racing fair and fast.
The only thing that changes… is the distance.

Week 1 → 1 km
Week 52 → 52 km

Early weeks reward raw power.
Later weeks demand patience, grit, and endurance.
The tide never stops rising.

Rolling Tide is about more than today’s finish line.
It’s about showing up — week after week.
Seeing the same names.
Measuring how far you’ve come as the distance stretches.

You’ll build rivalries.
You’ll track your progress.
You’ll remember the day it all began.

And by the end of the season, everyone who stayed will share the same truth:

“We rode the whole tide together.”

Why Join Rolling Collective?
We’re more than a club — we’re a global community of riders who support each other, grow together, and celebrate every ride, whether it’s a grind, a badge hunt, or a race. Join us on Discord, connect with fellow riders, and be part of something bigger.

Forward, Together

name: Torturefest | ITT Climbing League | City and the Sgurr | Week 1
description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.

Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift

These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder bike choices. 
•	No draft regardless of bike.
•	No Power up’s just you and your watts.
•	Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only 10km, elevation is primary focus.
•	Category enforced, must wear HRM.
•	ZwiftPower league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to zwift power.
•	Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
•	What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has multiple climbs?
•	How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?  

One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing Russian roulette style.

name: Zwift Crit Racing Club - Downtown Dolphin
description:
It's Crit time! Come and join in the fun on a number of multi-lap short routes. Get ready to dig deep and push to the finish line!

What is Racing Score?

Racing Score is an intuitive system that replaces the traditional categories (A - D) with a 0-1000 scale to reflect your current level, considering various metrics like race performances and power. This score helps Zwift recommend the most competitive band to race in, ensuring a fun, rewarding, and exciting experience as you track your progression throughout your Zwift racing adventures.

WHAT IS ZWIFT POWER? For further information on connecting to Zwift Power check out this support page: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/connecting-to-zwiftpower-SyldRc_4H

Please note; for your results to show up in Zwift Power you must be using a Heart Rate Monitor (HRM) and be riding on a smart trainer, smart bike, or using a power meter.

name: 2026 SISU World Championships - Gravel
description:
Coinciding with the 2026 UCI Road World Championships in Montréal, SISU Racing is excited to announce the 2026 SISU Worlds.
Across two weekends in September, riders will take on the ultimate test of speed, strength and race craft as we crown our 2026 SISU World Champions.


Individual Time Trial
19 - 20 September
Triple Flat Loops | Watopia
The Worlds begin with the race of truth. No drafting, nowhere to hide — just you, the clock and the watts.


Road Race
26 - 27 September
Bambino Fondo | Watopia
One week later, it’s time for the rainbow battle. Expect tactics, attacks, teamwork and a fight all the way to the line.


Gravel
10-11 October
Handful of Gravel | Watopia x 5 laps

It’s time to get dusty!


In true SISU style, we’re adding something extra.
Alongside our individual World Champions, we’ll also crown an Overall Champion in each grade (iTT + Road Race + Gravel) and SISU Country Champions, with the result determined by the combined times of the fastest three riders from each country.
Pull on your national colours, rally your compatriots and race for something bigger than yourself.


Further Information
Open event using Zwift's Racing Score with separate Women’s GC 
Each event is a mass start with all riders visible on the course.
TT bikes are mandatory for the iTT. Draft will be disabled.
Z Power and riders without heart rate data will be excluded from the results.
A rider's best time will count if they race the same discipline multiple times.
To be included in the GC riders must have a Zwiftpower profile.

name: Paceline Work
description:
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

This is a great workout for mimicking the demands of working in a paceline. Although gravel events feature mainly off-road and gnarly terrain, they also typically have asphalt and smoother dirt roads. Being able to stay in and work with a group as the speed inevitably increases over this terrain is crucial to achieve maximum speed due to the aerodynamic advantage gained.

WORKOUT DESIGNER

Shayne Gaffney (GC Coaching) holds a bachelors degree in Health Science in Professional Development and Advanced Patient Care, is a USA Cycling Level 1 (expert level) Certified Coach, a level 2 certified Training Peaks coach, a USA Cycling certified power based training coach, USA Olympic Committee Safe Sport Certified, and a licensed physical therapist assistant.  He is also the creator of Zwift's "Build Me Up" Flexible Training Plan.  He can be contacted directly via  for any cycling or training related questions.

For more information on GC Coaching, please visit www.gaffneycyclingcoaching.com

ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop. 

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level. For more info on FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

name: Tour Ignite - Stage 7
description:
Flamme Rouge Racing are excited to bring you our 6th tour Series, 3 Tour events from October through to March.

These will be PUBLIC availble events but if you want to be part of the official rankings then you will need to register and understand the rules, just visit.
Tours are special places, multi day events designed to test riders enduracne and resolve - so if you are popping in then enjoy the race be part of the race without destroying it as it's not a normal race.

https://www.flammerougeracing.com

Tour Aim
Multi day stage mixed racing for all classes of rider, generate fatigue and test how far you can go against your class. 
Anyone can race hard once a week but can you be competitive over a multiday event...only one way to find out!

Classification & PEN placement
ZRS wil place you in one of 5 staggered start Pens and your vELO class will rank you - Refer to the FRR Tour Rules page for mor einformation

Event Race Passes
Events are PUBLIC - join any race any time - your first completed race will count

Tour Rules
Ensure you are aware of the rules of the Tour to help you plan your survival strategy, all information can be found on our website...

Event Basics
- For each stage there are multiple race times
- Refer to the SCHEDULE page on the website for courses
- ALL SEGMENTS are in play 
- ALL RESULTS can be found on the website under the relevant page, these will periodically update through the day
- Keep going until the distance to go says 0 just in case there are some custom finishes

- There are no power ups for any stage
- Points stages use the ZWIFT AERO bike frame or TRON, ITT stages use the Zwift standard TT bike frame - riders may choose their own wheels
- Steering is always OFF

Tour Competition Awards
- Individuals can compete for GC (eGAP Time) / Polka Jersey / Sprint - by Gender for all classes

Queen/King Stage
Double points will be awarded as highlighted by the Schedule and/or Roadbook

Communication
Discord - Tour channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything on the Tour

Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS

Smart Trainers, Power Meters & HRM
- Events will not allow riders to join without a recognised Smart Trainer beign connected
- Smart Trainers are expected to be used as a riders PRIMARY POWER SOURCE where possible (Spin bikes must be declare to Race Control as these are NOT classed as smart trainers)
- POWER METERS can be used as Primary source if a Smart Trainer is not available
- Riders must understand that if verification is required that Race Control can verify with the Zwift platform if a rider has used a power meter as a primary power source over a smart trainer.

HRMs are strongly advised, the only reason we do not make them mandatory on joining an event is that sometimes they fail or batteries stop mid race so we do not want to penalise the accidents, however riders with little or no history we wil encourage to merchandise.

Why is this important - Video's may show that a riders BIO is fine and their setup looks good but this doesn't confirm that's what they used - we can now verify the trainer connected where required because it is known that PMs data can be altered and settings tweaked to produce more power.

So be SMART and use a SMART trainer as your PRIMARY power source where you can....

FRR Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anything more will be removed and warnings/bans will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the FRR events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt then welcome to the fun zone...! 
(But stop if it really does hurt too much please!)

name: Herd Summer Racing League
description:
Welcome to the Herd Summer Racing League (HSRL)

HSRL is a series of points races. The race format can be a little bit different week to week, but in
most of the races you score points for your time on each of the segments (FTS), versus the times
set by the other competitors. You also score bonus points for your finishing position in the race
versus your competitors in your category. Each week the race format, segments and points for
this race will be posted at the Herd Racing League facebook group and on the Herd Racing
discord channel.

General Classification

The points in each race are used to determine your ranking for the race. Your race rank
determines how many league points you receive, with the winner scoring 50 points, 2nd place
getting 49 and so on, down to 1 point for 50th place. Each week there are six different events to
choose from - choose whichever suits your schedule best.

Schedule

21-23 August: Scotland After Party - ITT + FTS
28-30 August: Innsbruckring (3 laps) - Points race FTS + FIN
4-6 September: Double Espresso - Points race FTS + FIN
11-13 September: Downtown Eruption - Scratch race
18-20 September: BRAEk-fast Crits & Grits - Points race FTS + FIN
25-27 September: Hot Laps - Points race FAL + FIN
2-4 October: Twilight Crit (6 laps) - Points race FTS + FIN
9-11 October: London Uprising - Points race FTS + FIN

Race rules:

1. Smarttrainer or powermeter required.
2. Cadence sensor required.
3. Heart rate monitor required.
4. No indoor bikes without controlled resistance (cadence=power).
5. Participants must be registered on zwiftpower.com to be included in the results.
6. For elite level performances the race organiser can request additional data to verify the
performance.
7. For podium finishers in all categories: Zwift activities must be saved PUBLIC for verification.

For more information please see our Facebook Group:
https://www.facebook.com/groups/zHerdRacing

description:
Welcome to the 4STAR Racing weekend Endurance ride. Join us each weekend for a 75km ride on a various courses.

The yellow beacon will ride at a 2.5 - 3.2wkg pace, whilst the red beacon will ride at a 2.0 - 2.5wkg pace.

About Us

name: Torturefest | ITT Climbing League | City and the Sgurr | Week 1
description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.

Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift

These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder bike choices. 
•	No draft regardless of bike.
•	No Power up’s just you and your watts.
•	Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only 10km, elevation is primary focus.
•	Category enforced, must wear HRM.
•	ZwiftPower league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to zwift power.
•	Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
•	What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has multiple climbs?
•	How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?  

One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing Russian roulette style.

name: The Grind Finale
description:
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

This session aims to replicate the demands of a mountain bike ride / event. 

Mountain biking generally involves far more variations in effort compared with road riding - so plenty of surges and time spent being over geared! We also spend a lot of time on and off the power, so short spells going  hard to get over an obstacle, followed by a freewheel or very low power on a descent or little dip.

We touch upon all of these aspects in todays session, as we start off alternating every 30 seconds between riding hard at a low cadence, and riding easy - as if we are riding through an undulating single track. Then we make a ramp in effort, which finishes with a 30 second near max effort up a steep, rocky banking!

WORKOUT DESIGNER

Matt Rowe - Heavily involved in cycling for the past 25 years, Matt represented Great Britain at the Junior World Championships before graduating to the pro ranks. Matt draws on his extensive race experience to help amateur cyclists around the world achieve their personal goals. 

ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop. 

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level. For more info on FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

name: Cycle Nation Endurance Ride
description:
Welcome to the Cycle Nation Endurance Rides. Join us for our series of weekend endurance rides aimed at Zwifters looking for group rides from 100km up to 300km. All riders are welcome to join the event and enjoy the friendly atmosphere and share banter. These are #DoubleDraft rides and as such it really helps if you try and stay in the main bunch and enjoy the draft. We ask that all riders respect the ride pace and stay around the leaders yellow beacon and not ride off the front.

name: INC Summer Endurance Ride Series
description:
INC Winter Endurance Ride – Sundays 5:30 AM (CET) 

 Do you measure rides in days, not hours? 
Do you know what it means to push through the night – chasing the horizon, legs on autopilot, mind in flow? 


Then welcome to the tribe. The Winter Endurance Ride is a steady, social endurance session for everyone who rides far – really far. This ride is for:  Randonneurs & Brevet riders who think 600k is just getting started, Transcontinental racers & ultra-distance addicts who live for the long haul, Bikepackers & 24-hour riders who know the beauty (and the madness) of riding through fatigue.  

And everyone else who just wants to challenge themselves with a solid 2–5 hour endurance session. We roll steady at 2.7–3.1 W/kg for 2–5 hours – no surges, no chaos, just that perfect endurance rhythm. The goal: build endurance, build mental strength, and share the mindset that defines true long-distance riders. 

 We talk routes, gear, sleep strategies, and the art of suffering with style. Whether you’re training for the next TCR, a 1200k brevet, or just want to ride steady with people who get it – this is your place. Ride steady. Ride far. Ride together. The long game starts here.

name: Tour Ignite - Queen Stage 8
description:
Flamme Rouge Racing are excited to bring you our 6th tour Series, 3 Tour events from October through to March.

These will be PUBLIC availble events but if you want to be part of the official rankings then you will need to register and understand the rules, just visit.
Tours are special places, multi day events designed to test riders enduracne and resolve - so if you are popping in then enjoy the race be part of the race without destroying it as it's not a normal race.

https://www.flammerougeracing.com

Tour Aim
Multi day stage mixed racing for all classes of rider, generate fatigue and test how far you can go against your class. 
Anyone can race hard once a week but can you be competitive over a multiday event...only one way to find out!

Classification & PEN placement
ZRS wil place you in one of 5 staggered start Pens and your vELO class will rank you - Refer to the FRR Tour Rules page for mor einformation

Event Race Passes
Events are PUBLIC - join any race any time - your first completed race will count

Tour Rules
Ensure you are aware of the rules of the Tour to help you plan your survival strategy, all information can be found on our website...

Event Basics
- For each stage there are multiple race times
- Refer to the SCHEDULE page on the website for courses
- ALL SEGMENTS are in play 
- ALL RESULTS can be found on the website under the relevant page, these will periodically update through the day
- Keep going until the distance to go says 0 just in case there are some custom finishes

- There are no power ups for any stage
- Points stages use the ZWIFT AERO bike frame or TRON, ITT stages use the Zwift standard TT bike frame - riders may choose their own wheels
- Steering is always OFF

Tour Competition Awards
- Individuals can compete for GC (eGAP Time) / Polka Jersey / Sprint - by Gender for all classes

Queen/King Stage
Double points will be awarded as highlighted by the Schedule and/or Roadbook

Communication
Discord - Tour channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything on the Tour

Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS

Smart Trainers, Power Meters & HRM
- Events will not allow riders to join without a recognised Smart Trainer beign connected
- Smart Trainers are expected to be used as a riders PRIMARY POWER SOURCE where possible (Spin bikes must be declare to Race Control as these are NOT classed as smart trainers)
- POWER METERS can be used as Primary source if a Smart Trainer is not available
- Riders must understand that if verification is required that Race Control can verify with the Zwift platform if a rider has used a power meter as a primary power source over a smart trainer.

HRMs are strongly advised, the only reason we do not make them mandatory on joining an event is that sometimes they fail or batteries stop mid race so we do not want to penalise the accidents, however riders with little or no history we wil encourage to merchandise.

Why is this important - Video's may show that a riders BIO is fine and their setup looks good but this doesn't confirm that's what they used - we can now verify the trainer connected where required because it is known that PMs data can be altered and settings tweaked to produce more power.

So be SMART and use a SMART trainer as your PRIMARY power source where you can....

FRR Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anything more will be removed and warnings/bans will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the FRR events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt then welcome to the fun zone...! 
(But stop if it really does hurt too much please!)

name: OTR Snap Crackle Pop Punch Time
description:
Snap Crackle Pop Punch Time is a group ride, race & interval training all rolled into one fun challenging event. Unique “race” scoring, where results in ZwiftPower are based on sum of segment times on a route with punchy climbs and/or sprints. Group rides together at ~2wkg, and ride leader provides guidance and lead-outs to smash a segment; then regroup, rinse & repeat. New route every week.

Multiple time slots on Fri-Sun, including Fri Atlantic, Sun APAC and Sun Americas/EMEA.
Riders need to join ZwiftPower.com to see their results as sum of segment times.

Event links: https://www.zwift.com/events/tag/snapcracklepop
Weekly results (across all time slots): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=2656
In-ride conversation (“SCP Ride” channel): https://discord.gg/B52qdExaW2
Chat, banter and results: https://discord.gg/HNzvx98srF

Group ride with all cats together at ~2w/kg. Yellow beacon / ride leader (when present) will provide instructions for each segment, and drop the fence when it's time to punch/sprint. Fence is for guidance only (non-zapping).

Ride at a relaxed pace between the timed segments.
Work together to optimize draft for faster segment times.
Slow or stop with yellow beacon after each segment to regroup.

All categories start in a single pen.
Results split per WKG category in ZwiftPower.
No power ups, default drafting, no TT bikes.

One of our regular SCP routes is 3.5 laps of Innsbruckring, with 4x Leg Snappers plus 3x sprints (stopping to regroup on the kicker in between). The challenge is to achieve sub 4 mins for the sum of 7 segment times for cats A/B (that's 45 secs per snapper plus 20 secs per sprint), sub 5 mins for cat C, and sub 7 mins for cat D. Best time to beat is 3:33.
Historical results for Leg Snapper: https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1322

This is a Evolution Cycling Club [EVO] Ladies only social Event and ride for all. Your co-operation and teamwork is essential to the success of the ride and we ask that all riders respect the pace set by the leader (Yellow Beacon). We may include intervals over and below the ride average advertised power range, but we will allow enough recovery and time to regroup after every effort. This is not a race, so please follow the leader beacon's (Yellow) instructions and if you are feeling strong we would welcome any help offered by stronger riders to bring any dropped riders back to the yellow beacon. We welcome good chat and a social atmosphere for new and experienced Zwifters alike, everyone is welcome.  The course each week will be recon for the WTRL TTT course the following Thursday.

description:
Zapraszamy na wspólny poranny event z ZTPL Cycling Club.
Z założenia nasze jazdy prowadzą liderzy, którzy pomagają trzymać peleton w ryzach. Jeśli podczas eventu zabraknie lidera, starajcie się trzymać tempo na które się umówiliśmy w momencie gdy dołączyliście do wybranej grupy. To od Was zależy jak będziecie się bawić 😊

name: Rowe & King - Fire Breather
description:
This is a group ride, with a difference! It will be 80 minutes, with the final 10 minutes a free for all race to the last second! 

The format of the ride is as follows;
10 Minutes easy as a warm up
20 Minutes ramped effort, to 85% of FTP
5 Minutes easy
3 x (20s Max effort sprint - 3 Minutes easy)
20 Minutes ramp down from 85% of FTP
10 Minutes full gas race
5 Minutes cool down

About Rowe & King Coaching:

The Rowe & King team are highly experienced cyclists and qualified coaches. Whether your goals are to become a professional cyclist, gain a 2nd cat licence, complete a sportive, perform at a specific event or simply becoming a better bike rider with a healthier lifestyle Rowe & King are ready to help you become a better cyclist, whatever that may mean to you.

Launched in 2015 Rowe & King, which has since grown to a team of 11 who help riders improve and work towards achieving their goals.

About - Rowe & King (roweandking.com) https://roweandking.com/about-rowe-and-king-cycling-coaching

name: Torturefest | ITT Climbing League | City and the Sgurr | Week 1
description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.

Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift

These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder bike choices. 
•	No draft regardless of bike.
•	No Power up’s just you and your watts.
•	Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only 10km, elevation is primary focus.
•	Category enforced, must wear HRM.
•	ZwiftPower league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to zwift power.
•	Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
•	What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has multiple climbs?
•	How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?  

One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing Russian roulette style.

name: LGBTQz Ride with Pride
description:
We invite everyone to join LGBTQ Zwifters and friends as we Ride with Pride all
year round. Our Sunday social ride is all about togetherness and most rides will use the rubber band so we can be one big, joyful bunch where everyone belongs. No surges, no stress, no getting left behind.  Our rides are inclusive and chat may involve LGBTQIA+ topics so please come with an open heart and open mind. 


You can check whether the rubber band will be in use by clicking the ‘Toggle Event Details’ link at the end of the event description on zwift.com.

Ride proud, ride together, and let’s make the miles brighter.

If you want to learn more about our Club, please visit: https://lgbtq-zwifters.com/

description:
Welcome to the L’Equipe Provence Badge Hunter Series! Our dedicated Team of Leaders and Sweepers created the concept of Zwift Badge Hunting and continue to refine, expand and perfect the art of the Hunt. Together, we share two goals: stacking badges and having fun! name: Hotchillee Race, Ride or Conquer Endurance ride
description:
The Hotchillee Race, Ride or Conquer ride is a series of Sunday morning endurance focussed races/rides that are a perfect way to get in a solid endurance session.

The routes will typically be in the 70-120 mins range but we might throw in some longer ones too.

The idea, just like a good sportive, is, no matter what your pace, you should find some wheels to ride with and, with double-draft enabled, should be able to hang on and tick that route off.

If you want a couple of spicy midweek rides, check out Hotchillee WOT (Watts on Tuesday) on Tuesdays at 1830 and the Hotchillee Gain Train at 1830 on Thursdays.

Check out Hotchillee IRL events and our community at *www.hotchillee.com*

name: PAOLO BARBERA & SCANNELLATORI SERIALI WORKOUT
description:
"Scannellatori Seriali" is a large community of cyclists, triathletes, and runners. We invite you to join our community by following our Instagram page at https://www.instagram.com/scannellatori_seriali/ or contacting us on Facebook.
 
Coach Paolo Barbera (Please visit www.heycoach.it )   is a Certified Triathlon and Ironman Coach and the founder of Active Kids, a sporting clinic to help children and adults in the prevention and treatment of obesity through healty nutrition and tailored training programs

Paolo is an experienced thriathlete and cyclist, in 2017 opened an endurance training center in milan, Tri60, specilized in indoor training.

In the last ten years Paolo has developed training programs for triathletes, runners and cyclists. Indoor training plays a key role to control pace, cadence and mental strenght.

Paolo’s workouts are designed to mix different training zones aiming to maximize results in a very short time. Paolo’s coachees by following his workouts, at the right intensity, have achieved challenging results.

name: Het is Koers in the Dutch mountains
description:
Het is Koers, the famous Dutch cycling blog presents you a variety of social rides. At Sunday morning we go "in the Dutch Mountains"
Between 1st Sunday of October until the last Sunday of March, we will offer you a medium paced endurance ride with social characteristics.
Meaning a ride leader will guide you through the hills and mountains that Zwift has to offer. All riders are encouraged to keep the bunch together, so we can start and finish as one happy blob.
On the flats we will ride about 2.5 w/kg and on the climbs around 3.0 w/kg reflecting a C-category ride.

Between 1st Sunday of April until last Sunday of September HIK presents you with a variety of free rides (no lead) through the Dutch mountains. On weekly basis you can ride with other C-category riders, wanting to ride uphill.
Check out our weekly ride announcements on the HIK Facebook https://www.facebook.com/groups/hetiskoers
Join Het Is Koers on Zwift https://www.zwift.com/clubs/HetIsKoers/home

eventSubgroups.description:
Het is Koers, the famous Dutch cycling blog presents you a variety of social rides. At Sunday morning we go "in the Dutch Mountains"
Between 1st Sunday of October until the last Sunday of March, we will offer you a medium paced endurance ride with social characteristics.
Meaning a ride leader will guide you through the hills and mountains that Zwift has to offer. All riders are encouraged to keep the bunch together, so we can start and finish as one happy blob.
On the flats we will ride about 2.5 w/kg and on the climbs around 3.0 w/kg reflecting a C-category ride.

Between 1st Sunday of April until last Sunday of September HIK presents you with a variety of free rides (no lead) through the Dutch mountains. On weekly basis you can ride with other C-category riders, wanting to ride uphill.
Check out our weekly ride announcements on the HIK Facebook https://www.facebook.com/groups/hetiskoers
Join Het Is Koers on Zwift https://www.zwift.com/clubs/HetIsKoers/home
Other HIK events:
Watts More! (C) 2.5-3.0 W/kg, Tuesday 19.00 CET
Something Different! (D) 2.2-2.3 W/kg, Thursday 19.15 CET
Weekend Starter! (D) 1.7-2.2 W/kg and (C) 2.3-2.8 W/kg, Friday 19.30 CET
Endurance Recovery! (C) 2.2-2.6 W/kg, Saturday 9.00 AM CET

name: ZU4R eSport Masochist Climber
description:
ZU4R Sportswear has the pleasure to invite you to the ZU4R eSport Masochist Climber series 2022. Here we will challenge, cheer on, support and put each other in competition, in a series of climbs up the Alpe du Zwift – Road to Sky.

In addition to the community, we have the following badges as objectives:
• Avid Climber: Climb the Alpe 5 times
• Masochist: Climb the Alpe 25 times
• Lift Off: Finish Alpe in under an hour
And of course - the climbing wheels: Lightweight Meilenstein, which you can get on the wheel of fortune at the top of AdZ. Collecting altitude meters for the Zwift Consept bike Z1 (Tron) bike can also be a goal for those who do not have this bike.

More information about ZU4R eSport: https://www.zu4resport.com
We use the Voice channel "Masochist Climber» at ZU4R eSport Discord-server: https://discord.gg/RMVde96aqb

Welcome – ride together – RIDE ON 👍

name: PACK Run: Smile for Miles
description:
PACK Run Smile for Miles is the answer to how to start your Sunday the right way. We will usually run one lap of a short route and then offer an after party for whatever distance you desire. Come for the banter, the confections, and smiles and leave with a sense of accomplishment and community. https://www.facebook.com/groups/zwiftpack/
#StrongerTogether #MaythePackBewithYou

name: Watts More To the Top!
description:
Watts More! Ride with friends in challenging events. Take on your challenge in Watts, elevation or duration! 

At Sunday morning we go To the top! A rideleader will guide you through the hills and mountains that Zwift has to offer. On the flats we will ride about 2.5 w/kg and on the climbs around 3.0 w/kg reflecting a C-category ride. All riders are encouraged to keep the bunch together, so we can start and finish as one happy blob. During the season we build up the elevation meters. 

From October until March these rides are guided with a rideleader. From April until September the rides are without rideleader. In that case don’t argue, blob up and be nice.  
 
Check out our weekly ride announcements on the Watts More Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/1151203888657006/?ref=share 

 Join Watts More on Zwift  https://www.zwift.com/clubs/d6afeaa7-e754-478a-b68d-2a794648fa02/home  

 
Other Watts More events: 
Build more Watts! (C) 2.5-3.0 W/kg, Tuesday 19.00 CET  
Different Watts! (D) 2.2-2.4 W/kg, Thursday 19.00 CET 
Rendurance! (C) 2.2-2.6 W/kg, Saturday 9.00 AM CET

name: Vikings Valhalla Sunday Skaal ride
description:
Welcome to the Vikings Valhalla Sunday Skaal ride. 

We would love to have you join us to toast a ride together to end the week. Our rides are very inclusive with a ‘’no one gets dropped’’ approach. We encourage riders to respect the leader's pace and ride with the yellow beacon. This is NOT A RACE! Stronger riders are encouraged to fall back and help sweep the riders struggling in the back. If you are looking for a fun ride with lots of Skaal this is the perfect ride for you.

Come and try us..

For more information about our rides go to: https://www.facebook.com/groups/503388660165279/

name: Norwegian Watts Club Endurance Ride
description:
Welcome to Norwegian Watts Endurance Ride

When it’s getting cold and wet outside, it’s time to get inside and get the hours in. Join us for a chill and kind spirited century ride. You don’t have to stay for the whole ride, but all finishers will be rewarded our awesome jersey.

The aim is to keep the group together, chatting and having
fun. This is a group ride, not a race!

Pace 1,7-2,1 w/kg

The ride leader will aim to ride mid parameters, but there might be slight variations above or below the average during the ride.

NB:
Please always respect the ride leader and follow his/her
instructions.

name: SZR Groupworkouts by Aktivitus
description:
These WOs are designed to give you improved aerobic development and increased aerobic threshold (LT1) -endurance - in a 2h workout. To get most out of this session, make sure your FTP is correct set. If you are aerobic underdeveloped for cycling you may need to decrease your FTP-settings.

The workout is 120min and starts with a 15min warmup. First main block is 3x15min at a controlled threshold/Sweet spot (90% of FTP) on lower cadences to wear us down and to get a time effective local aerobic development and cycling strength (endurance).

The second block contains 20x30/60sek intervals. 30sec at 150% of FTP with a 1min active rest. This is highly anaerobic which gives us an improved lactic tolerance and an increased anaerobic stanima. However, in a worn-out state these intervals will also stress your aerobic development. That means you oxygen transport into your working muscles will get better. Your endurance will thereby increase.

This WO is designed Johan Hasselmark at Aktivitus (www.aktivitus.se). Aktivitus runs Swedens leading test and coaching operations for endurance sports.
Johan Hasselmark is an international level adventure racer and extreme triathlete with several wins, 30 years of competative experince in endurance sports and 8 years of coaching and physiological testing.

name: Stage 1 - Race - Tour of Watopia 2026
description:
Once a Year. Twice the XP.

New levels are here, and Double XP is the fastest way to reach them. Take on five epic stages throughout Watopia and earn Double XP along the way. It’s your chance to explore brand-new routes, unlock iconic rewards, and stack bonus XP on top of the Double XP while you’re at it.

STAGE 1
Route: Sand and Sequoias
Distance: 20.1 km // 12.5 miles
Elevation: 175 meters // 574 ft
PowerUps: Feather, Draft
Date: Oct 5—12

STAGE 2
Route: Downtown Eruption
Distance: 19.4 km // 12.1 miles
Elevation: 275 meters // 902 ft
PowerUps: Feather, Anvil
Date: Oct 12—19

Stage 3
Route: Coastal Crown Loop
Distance: 15 km // 9.3 miles
Elevation: 185 meters // 607 ft
PowerUps: Feather, Ghost
Date: Oct 19—26

Stage 4
Route: California Roll
Distance: 33.2 km // 20.7 miles
Elevation: 168 meters // 552 ft
PowerUps: Draft, Aero
Date: Oct 26—Nov 2

Stage 5
Route: Molten Momentum
Distance: 20.8 km // 12.9 miles
Elevation: 245 meters // 804 ft
PowerUps: Feather, Draft
Date: Nov 2—9

MONTHLY GC COMPETITION

Looking for extra motivation? The GC (General Classification) Competition lets you track your progress across all stages. Each race counts—your times add up throughout the series, shaping the overall standings. At the end of the month, the fastest total time takes the win!

VIEW RESULTS: http://zwift.com/racing/leagues/tourofwatopia2026
—------------------
Zwift Racing Score is aimed at pairing you with riders of similar racing abilities to keep racing fun, fair, and competitive. Read the FAQ here: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh

ADVANCED CATEGORY = 650+
CATEGORY RANGE 1 = 0-159 | 160-269 | 270-389 | 390-509 | 510-649
CATEGORY RANGE 2 = 0-209 | 210-329 | 330-449 | 450-569 | 570-724
WOMEN'S EVENTS = Dedicated women's races available throughout the series.

For riders with a Racing Score of 650 or higher, the' Advanced' category will have separate events scheduled every other hour.

Please note that in order to enter the Advanced category, you will need the following:
Heart Rate Monitor
Zwift Racing Score of over 650
Smart Trainer/Bike or Power Meter

Hourly racing will be split into five tighter categories for more exciting competition. Plus, with hourly alternating category ranges, you’ll have more options to find races that suit your level.

name: ZZRC Wacky Chase
description:
Welcome to ZZRC’s Wacky Chase!

Get ready to saddle up for an unforgettable adventure that combines pace, fun, and a dash of friendly competition! Our group rides are open to all riders, and we’ve constructed a delightful two paced category to ensure everyone can enjoy a safe and top-notch experience on two wheels.

Here’s the game plan: we’ve divided our crew into two spirited teams. Team B will zoom at a snappy 3.2-3.8 pace, Team C will enjoy a smooth cruise at 2.4-2.8. We’re throwing in a twist of excitement with a hot chase. Team C takes off first from the pen, followed swiftly by Team B.

This isn’t just another group ride; it’s your ticket to banter, camaraderie, and a good ol’ time! Our leaders will guide you, sharing pacing tips and tricks along the way. Remember, teamwork makes the dream work, so use that draft to your advantage as you barrel through the ride together!

A couple of quick housekeeping notes: we’re keeping the atmosphere all-inclusive and relaxed, with a focus on enjoyment rather than perfection. Sweeps and Ride Buddies will be off-duty this time, so if you find yourself lagging behind, feel free to continue at your own pace or buddy up with fellow riders nearby.

And hey, we’ve got a little rule: leave the TT Bikes at home! They don’t draft well and might make you puff and pant a bit more than you want. Mountain bikes? They’re welcome too, just be prepared to push a little harder than the folks on road bikes. No worries if you hit a snag; our 30-minute late join feature will let you teleport back to the main group with the magical YELLOW BEACON!

We’re all about chatting and having fun while we ride, so don’t miss out on our dedicated Discord channel! Join us, choose your pace, and get ready to share the laughs as we roll.

**Top Tips for Wacky Chase Success:**

1. Stick close to your ride leader; don’t let that gap turn into a canyon!

2. Avoid the fence—we want you in one piece, not fried!

3. Most importantly… HAVE FUN! This is all about the adventure.

Don’t forget to connect with us on our ZZRC Facebook page and join the club on the companion app for all the latest gossip and rides!

So get your cycling gear on, bring your best vibes, and let’s hit the Zwift Roads together!

Discord Channel

https://discord.com/channels/1009379476041383946/1009388181269004289

name: Foudre Sunday Coffee Ride
description:
Sortie dominicale Foudre : Foudre Sunday Coffee Ride

INTRO
La Team Foudre vous propose de venir évacuer les toxines de Mirabelle de la vieille, de passer un moment ensemble pour peaufiner votre endurance, et s'amuser lors des sprints pour les plus valeureux.
Lors de cette sortie plus longue, nous arpenterons des parcours variés et plus longs. Il s’agit d’une sortie de groupe conviviale et non d’une course, n’hésitez pas à venir nous rejoindre sur le canal vocal général sur le Discord.

DETAILS
Durée : 1h30 mais vous pourrez poursuivre et boucler le parcours si vous n’avez encore débloqué le badge du parcours
Join-Late : Activé
Déblocage du maillot Foudre : Oui, à condition d'être toujours dans l'évènement lorsque celui-ci se termine

GROUPES
2 groupes de niveau :
- LEADER (jaune) environ 2,5 w/kg (2,5 à 3,0 dans les montées)
- SWEEPER (rouge) environ 2,2 w/kg. (2,5 à 3,0 dans les montées) »

REGROUPEMENT
Nous essayons après chaque difficulté de faire en sorte que les groupes se reforment autour des leaders.
Rester donc près de votre leader pour éviter d’être distancé et vous retrouver seul. Si vous êtes lâchés, n’hésitez pas à prévenir au plus tôt (sur discord ou par message sur Zwift) pour se regrouper ou trouver d'autres coureurs pour vous regrouper.

Pour profiter au maximum de la sortie, rejoins nous sur le discord Foudre et notamment sur l'audio via l'oreillette : https://discord.gg/YzcVYJY

#TeamFoudre #jerseyunlock

name: Flanders Endurance Race
description:
Prepare your racing and climbing skills for the Flanders Endurance Race League.
This league are open races (held on Sunday) build on stamina. Races will be longer dan 2 hours.
Please note the race is from the gun, including any event 'warm-up' on the lap counter. Categories will all start together.

RACE RULES

No powerups.
No TT bikes.
Heart rate monitors are compulsory for "all" categories.
Power Meter and Smart Trainer winners take category win.
zPower riders will not be included in zwiftpower results

Riders must opt-in to ZwiftPower for official results via their Zwift profile settings @ https://my.zwift.com/profile/connectionsOpens a new window
Riders must register an account @ www.zwiftpower.comOpens a new window and agree to the T&C's to be included in official results.
Riders going over 5w/kg at 95% of 20 minute power will be removed from results.
Riders going over 6w/kg for 5 minute power will be removed from results.
Official results located @ www.zwiftpower.comOpens a new window

It is essential that all participants are honest and select the correct pen/category below which correlates to their current/potential FTP. (Please use your FTP divided by your weight in kg to select the correct category below.) Riders that have at least 3 ZP results (in their race history) on a higher FTP category level than the chosen one will be DQ'd ! If you're in doubt, please contact the organizer for more information.

NOTE : if you have a ZP cat tag lower than your W/kg FTP due to low body weight choose your FTP cat ! Example : Rider with an FTP of 4.5 W/kg but a B tag on ZP because of <250W will race A and not B !
The organizer can DQ riders when in doubt of performance and awaiting the correct info of the rider, the rider has to contact the organizer to discuss this matter.

CATEGORIES

(A) 4.0 W/kg FTP or higher
(B) 3.2 W/kg to 3.99 W/kg FTP
(C) 2.5 W/kg to 3.19 W/kg FTP
(D) Under 2.49 W/kg FTP

Our BZR stream Channels :
https://www.twitch.tv/tsbikerOpens a new window

eventSubgroups.name: Flanders Endurance Race  (D)
eventSubgroups.description:
Prepare your racing and climbing skills for the Flanders Endurance Race League.
This league are open races (held on Sunday) build on stamina. Races will be longer dan 2 hours.
Please note the race is from the gun, including any event 'warm-up' on the lap counter. Categories will all start together.

RACE RULES

No powerups.
No TT bikes.
Heart rate monitors are compulsory for "all" categories.
Power Meter and Smart Trainer winners take category win.
zPower riders will not be included in zwiftpower results

Riders must opt-in to ZwiftPower for official results via their Zwift profile settings @ https://my.zwift.com/profile/connectionsOpens a new window
Riders must register an account @ www.zwiftpower.comOpens a new window and agree to the T&C's to be included in official results.
Riders going over 5w/kg at 95% of 20 minute power will be removed from results.
Riders going over 6w/kg for 5 minute power will be removed from results.
Official results located @ www.zwiftpower.comOpens a new window

It is essential that all participants are honest and select the correct pen/category below which correlates to their current/potential FTP. (Please use your FTP divided by your weight in kg to select the correct category below.) Riders that have at least 3 ZP results (in their race history) on a higher FTP category level than the chosen one will be DQ'd ! If you're in doubt, please contact the organizer for more information.

NOTE : if you have a ZP cat tag lower than your W/kg FTP due to low body weight choose your FTP cat ! Example : Rider with an FTP of 4.5 W/kg but a B tag on ZP because of <250W will race A and not B !
The organizer can DQ riders when in doubt of performance and awaiting the correct info of the rider, the rider has to contact the organizer to discuss this matter.

CATEGORIES

(A) 4.0 W/kg FTP or higher
(B) 3.2 W/kg to 3.99 W/kg FTP
(C) 2.5 W/kg to 3.19 W/kg FTP
(D) Under 2.49 W/kg FTP

name: La Cyclo MedioFondo Foudre - Age & Women categories⚡️!
description:
CATEGORIES
A: < 39 ans
B: 40-49 ans
C: 50-59 ans
D: > 60 ans
E: Féminine

FRANCAIS

INTRO :
A l’image des Cyclosportives, nous vous proposons de participer tous les Dimanche matin à une Cyclo sur Zwift, d’une durée d’environ 2h et avec ranking.
Viens participer pour viser la performance, tenter de te dépasser ou simplement pour te balader en groupe avec les amis et coureurs de même niveau.
Lors de ces évènements, nous arpenterons des parcours divers et variés, régulièrement vallonnés.
Le départ sera groupé entre toutes les catégories, des groupes de niveau se créeront lors des différentes difficultés du parcours.
Pas de bonus FAL/FTS, les Power-Ups sont et le steering sont désactivé.

RÈGLES :
L'inscription sur Zwiftpower.com est nécessaire pour apparaître au classement de la manche et au classement général.
Les zPower (Home Trainer sans capteur de puissance) seront supprimés des résultats.
Les vélos de contre la montre ne sont pas autorisés, sauf indication contraire.
Les moniteurs de fréquence cardiaque sont obligatoires pour toutes les catégories.
Le double enregistrement de capture de puissance est obligatoire pour les meilleures performances, dans toutes les catégories*.
*Toutefois, s’il ne vous est pas possible de fournir une double analyse (ex : pas de capteur de puissance externe), cela ne sera pas forcément signe de disqualification. Une analyse sera effectuée par un organisateur concernant votre puissance, cardio et données de performances IRL accessible sur votre compte Strava, afin de vous déclasser ou non.


ENGLISH

INTRO:
We invite you to participate every Sunday morning in a 2h race, with ranking, such as IRL MedioFondos.
Come and participate to aim for performance, try to surpass yourself or simply to ride in a group with friends and eCyclists of the same level.
During these races, we will ride various and varied courses, most of the time hilly roads.
All the racers will start together, groups of level will probably be created during the different difficulties of the course.
No FAL/FTS bonus, Power-Up and steering are disabled.

RULES:
Registration on Zwiftpower.com is required to be ranked.
zPower (Smart Trainer without power meter) will be removed from the results.
Time trial bikes are not allowed unless otherwise specified.
Heart rate monitors are mandatory for all categories.
Dual (power) record is mandatory for the top performances. All categories*.
*However, if it is not possible for you to provide a double analysis (e.g. no external power meter), this will not necessarily be a sign of disqualification. Indeed, an analysis will be made by the organizers regarding your power, heart rate, and IRL performances accessible on Strava account, to keep you or not in the results.

name: Zwift Racing League Recon Ride (BEAT CYCLING CLUB)
description:
This ZRL Group Recon Ride is led by BEAT Cycling Club (https://www.zwift.com/clubs/35cca0e7-d713-46d4-8fa7-7c8dd012d8c7).

Zwift Racing League Group Recon Rides are the official non-competitive Group Rides. Each one is hosted/run by a participating club and will feature racing tips and tricks for the race ahead, an opportunity to ask questions relating to Zwift Racing League and to preview the full course for Tuesday’s ZRL races.

THE AIM
With experienced ride leaders and Zwifters from a reputable Zwift Club, this is your opportunity to ask questions about all things ZRL-related. You'll be able to learn useful course and team tactics and if you are new to ZRL - perhaps even find a team to race with too!

There are multiple Group Recon Rides to choose from each day at various times and each will operate at the advertised paces (pace is based on your Zwift Pace Group).

WHAT IS THE ZRL?
Introducing the spectacular Zwift Racing League (ZRL) - a turbocharged online bike racing extravaganza that's rewriting the rules of competition. With a staggering 180 community divisions, 1,800 electrifying teams, and a whopping 14,000 fierce racers per 6-week round, the ZRL stands as the undisputed heavyweight champion of online bike racing competitions worldwide.

This high-octane spectacle is masterfully orchestrated by our powerhouse partners, WTRL, who leave no stone unturned in delivering an unparalleled racing experience. But remember, this race is an invitation-only affair, so if you dare to join the ranks of speed demons and thrill-seekers, you'll need to hitch a ride with one of the esteemed existing teams. Fear not, though, for WTRL's website (www.WTRL.racing) is your portal to all the insider intel - schedule, rules, and even a team that perfectly aligns with your fiery spirit!

If you want to gather your own team, you register for the next Round of ZRL at www.wtrl.racing/zwift-racing-league/.

#zrlrecon #wtrl #zrl #beat

name: Pride Run
description:
Join with members of the LGBTQ+ community as we stride with Pride! 

Runs are hosted by LGBTQ Zwifters Club and we invite you to join our weekly rainbow run! In some runs you will find a leader to make it social and help keep you motivated. If you are in training for a duathlon or triathlon, you can even join a Pride Ride before your run, since runs are scheduled 30 min after each Pride ride ends. Our runs are inclusive, we value diversity and courage, and we are always respectful. Social chat may involve LGBTQ+ topics so please come with an open heart and open mind. 

If you want to learn more about our Club and socials, please visit: https://lgbtq-zwifters.com/

name: Run 10K Every Day Powered By NoblePro
description:
Come and join the longest running daily led running event on Zwift. This was the event that kickstarted the NoblePro Running Club in support of a world record attempt at consecutive daily10k runs.
The event has a healthy group of leaders who are friendly and chatty and will help you achieve your goal, not matter your experience. Feel free to join in the chat and become addicted like we all are.

Whether you are a beginner or experienced runner come and join us, you can run at whatever pace you like, it's not a race.
If you don't want to run 10k then come along for as long as you wish, the support is always appreciated.
The event runs at the same time each day, each day of the week there is a different course.

NoblePro: - We are a team focused on elevating running through our treadmills and digital platforms. We create treadmills loved by runners and the wider running community for quality engineered hardware features and advanced software integration to give you the freedom to train with the apps you love.
https://www.noble-pro.com/

Kinni:- In a fitness world where treadmill bluetooth integration can be a confusing place, we aim to provide you with the ability to effortlessly connect. You can run structured treadmill workouts, connect and integrate with your favourite bluetooth fitness apps such as Zwift, Rouvy, Kinomaps and many more. We are focused on progress and advancement in integration, connectivity and control.
https://kinni.co/

https://kinni.co/devices/ - To see if your treadmill is compatible to link to Zwift.

Join the NoblePro Running Club (NPRC) - https://www.zwift.com/clubs/e7829ccd-bce4-4244-9ccf-4cdc3ef148ff/home

name: WELCOME TO THE BRAUNSTEIN CYCLING CLUB DANISH GROUP RIDE
description:
This is a social group workout; a chance every week for members to get together from around the globe, ride, chat and support each other - it’s run as a group workout session with ‘keep everyone together’ enabled so no matter what your pace you’ll stay in the pack - it’s not a race or competition and open for anyone to join us.

WHO IS THE BCC?

The BRAUNSTEIN Cycling Club (BCC) is, as the name suggests, Braunstein brewery’s Cycling Club. The BCC is a danish social Cycling club were we share our passion for Cycling.

For more information head to: www.braunstein.dk/bcc2

RIDE LEADERS

The rides are led by our friendly team of member ride leaders. The Leader (who has a yellow beacon over their head) will ride at a steady pace as set by the workout session. On most occasions we will have a support ride leader (who will also have a beacon), the ride leaders are there to help support you and keep the banter going - to join the chat use the Zwift Companion smartphone app.

Map/Route — Wattopia
Distance/Time/Laps — 1 hour
Type of Event - Group Ride
ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop.
